title: Hands Up Sister
prompt: dance pop in the style of the band big sis
description: A punchy TR-808 groove in C minor kicks hard from the first bar, with a saw-filtered bass riff and a delayed square-wave melody doubling the energy through a series of escalating peaks. A moody breakdown drops to half-time swagger before a final section layers running eighth-note hi-hats and octave-doubled lead lines into a peak-time climax.
